metaDescription: Order custom round badge ID holders for your team. Perfect for events, security, and identification. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Round badge ID holders offer a distinctive alternative to standard rectangular holders, making them ideal for trade shows, conferences, and security badges where a unique shape helps attendees stand out. The circular design provides a clean, modern look that pairs well with full-color ID inserts. Choose from clear vinyl or durable nylon options, and add your logo or text through screen printing or full-color sublimation for a polished, professional finish.
heroAltText: Custom round badge ID holders with clear vinyl and full-color printed inserts for events
